//! Usage ledger aggregation and tree-sum logic.
//!
//! This module extends [`UsageLedger`] with methods for aggregating usage
//! records and provides [`compute_agent_usage_summary`] for tree-sum
//! computation without double-counting.
//!
//! The **"unknown is not zero"** invariant is preserved throughout all
//! aggregation — if any operand is unknown (`None`) the result remains
//! unknown.

use harness_protocol::usage::{ModelUsage, UsageRecord, UsageValue};

use crate::agent::UsageLedger;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AgentUsageSummary — tree‑sum breakdown
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// A three-level summary of an agent's token usage.
///
/// - [`self_usage`](AgentUsageSummary::self_usage): usage from this agent's
///   own records only (direct backend requests).
/// - [`descendant_usage`](AgentUsageSummary::descendant_usage): usage from
///   all descendant agents (children, grandchildren, …).
/// - [`inclusive_usage`](AgentUsageSummary::inclusive_usage):  the total
///   usage attributable to this agent (`self_usage + descendant_usage`).
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AgentUsageSummary {
    /// Usage from this agent's own records.
    pub self_usage: ModelUsage,
    /// Usage from all descendant agents (children, grandchildren, etc.).
    pub descendant_usage: ModelUsage,
    /// Total usage = self + descendant (no double counting).
    pub inclusive_usage: ModelUsage,
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// UsageLedger methods
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

impl UsageLedger {
    /// Creates a new empty usage ledger.
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        UsageLedger {
            records: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    /// Adds a single usage record to the ledger.
    pub fn add_record(&mut self, record: UsageRecord) {
        self.records.push(record);
    }

    /// Aggregates all records in this ledger into a single [`ModelUsage`].
    ///
    /// This only includes this agent's **own** records — descendant usage
    /// is computed separately via [`compute_agent_usage_summary`].
    pub fn self_usage(&self) -> ModelUsage {
        self.aggregate(&self.records)
    }

    /// Internal helper: sums a slice of records field-by-field using
    /// [`UsageValue::checked_add`] so the "unknown is not zero" invariant
    /// is preserved.
    fn aggregate(&self, records: &[UsageRecord]) -> ModelUsage {
        // Start from an all-unknown baseline.
        let mut result = ModelUsage {
            input_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
            output_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
            cache_read_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
            cache_write_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
            reasoning_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
            total_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
        };

        for record in records {
            result = ModelUsage {
                input_tokens: result
                    .input_tokens
                    .checked_add(record.model_usage.input_tokens),
                output_tokens: result
                    .output_tokens
                    .checked_add(record.model_usage.output_tokens),
                cache_read_tokens: result
                    .cache_read_tokens
                    .checked_add(record.model_usage.cache_read_tokens),
                cache_write_tokens: result
                    .cache_write_tokens
                    .checked_add(record.model_usage.cache_write_tokens),
                reasoning_tokens: result
                    .reasoning_tokens
                    .checked_add(record.model_usage.reasoning_tokens),
                total_tokens: result
                    .total_tokens
                    .checked_add(record.model_usage.total_tokens),
            };
        }

        result
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tree‑sum aggregation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// Computes a tree-sum usage summary for an agent.
///
/// Given this agent's own records and the summaries of all direct children,
/// this function computes:
///
/// - **`self_usage`** — aggregated from `self_records`.
/// - **`descendant_usage`** — sum of every child's `inclusive_usage`.
/// - **`inclusive_usage`** — `self_usage + descendant_usage` (no double
///   counting, because each child's `inclusive_usage` already includes
///   *its* descendants).
///
/// The "unknown is not zero" invariant is preserved throughout — if any
/// field is unknown in any record or child summary, the corresponding
/// aggregate field remains unknown.
pub fn compute_agent_usage_summary(
    self_records: &[UsageRecord],
    child_summaries: &[AgentUsageSummary],
) -> AgentUsageSummary {
    // 1. Self-usage: aggregate this agent's own records.
    let self_usage = UsageLedger {
        records: self_records.to_vec(),
    }
    .self_usage();

    // 2. Descendant usage: sum every child's inclusive_usage.
    let mut descendant_usage = ModelUsage {
        input_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
        output_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
        cache_read_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
        cache_write_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
        reasoning_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
        total_tokens: UsageValue::new(None),
    };

    for child in child_summaries {
        descendant_usage = ModelUsage {
            input_tokens: descendant_usage
                .input_tokens
                .checked_add(child.inclusive_usage.input_tokens),
            output_tokens: descendant_usage
                .output_tokens
                .checked_add(child.inclusive_usage.output_tokens),
            cache_read_tokens: descendant_usage
                .cache_read_tokens
                .checked_add(child.inclusive_usage.cache_read_tokens),
            cache_write_tokens: descendant_usage
                .cache_write_tokens
                .checked_add(child.inclusive_usage.cache_write_tokens),
            reasoning_tokens: descendant_usage
                .reasoning_tokens
                .checked_add(child.inclusive_usage.reasoning_tokens),
            total_tokens: descendant_usage
                .total_tokens
                .checked_add(child.inclusive_usage.total_tokens),
        };
    }

    // 3. Inclusive usage: self + descendant.
    let inclusive_usage = ModelUsage {
        input_tokens: self_usage
            .input_tokens
            .checked_add(descendant_usage.input_tokens),
        output_tokens: self_usage
            .output_tokens
            .checked_add(descendant_usage.output_tokens),
        cache_read_tokens: self_usage
            .cache_read_tokens
            .checked_add(descendant_usage.cache_read_tokens),
        cache_write_tokens: self_usage
            .cache_write_tokens
            .checked_add(descendant_usage.cache_write_tokens),
        reasoning_tokens: self_usage
            .reasoning_tokens
            .checked_add(descendant_usage.reasoning_tokens),
        total_tokens: self_usage
            .total_tokens
            .checked_add(descendant_usage.total_tokens),
    };

    AgentUsageSummary {
        self_usage,
        descendant_usage,
        inclusive_usage,
    }
}

//! Transcript invariant validation for the harness core.
//!
//! This module provides [`validate_transcript`] — a function that enforces
//! the structural transcript invariant (spec §60):
//!
//! > Every `assistant(tool_call)` must be followed by a matching
//! > `tool_result` before the next conversational message.
//!
//! Violations are reported via the [`TranscriptError`] enum.

use std::collections::HashMap;

use harness_protocol::ids::ToolCallId;
use harness_protocol::messages::{AgentMessage, ContentBlock, MessageRole};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// TranscriptError
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// Errors that can occur during transcript validation.
///
/// Each variant carries the offending [`ToolCallId`] so callers can pinpoint
/// the exact message pair that violates the invariant.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum TranscriptError {
    /// A conversational message (User or System) was encountered while one or
    /// more tool calls were still pending resolution.
    #[error("Dangling unresolved tool call: {0}")]
    DanglingToolCall(ToolCallId),

    /// A tool result was encountered without a preceding tool-use declaration.
    #[error("Tool result {0} without preceding tool call")]
    OrphanToolResult(ToolCallId),

    /// A tool result appears at an earlier position than the assistant message
    /// that declared the tool call — impossible ordering.
    #[error("Tool result {0} appears before the assistant message that made the call")]
    OutOfOrderToolResult(ToolCallId),

    /// A tool call was declared in an assistant message but never resolved
    /// by a corresponding tool-result message by the end of the transcript.
    #[error("Tool call {0} has no corresponding result")]
    UnresolvedToolCall(ToolCallId),
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// validate_transcript
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// Validates the structural transcript invariant for a slice of messages.
///
/// # Invariant
///
/// For every `ContentBlock::ToolUse` in an assistant message, there must be a
/// matching `ContentBlock::ToolResult` in a subsequent tool message **before**
/// the next conversational message (User or System).  At the end of the
/// transcript, every tool call must have been resolved.
///
/// # Algorithm
///
/// 1. Walk messages in order, maintaining a `pending_calls` map from
///    [`ToolCallId`] to the message index where it was declared.
/// 2. Assistant messages: add each `ToolUse` block to `pending_calls`.
/// 3. Tool messages: remove each matching `ToolResult` from `pending_calls`.
///    Error if the result has no matching declaration (orphan) or if its
///    position precedes the declaration (out-of-order).
/// 4. User/System messages: error if `pending_calls` is non-empty (dangling).
/// 5. After all messages: error if `pending_calls` is non-empty (unresolved).
///
/// # Examples
///
/// ```
/// // Valid transcript: tool_call → tool_result → user
/// // Invalid transcript: dangling unresolved call
/// // Invalid transcript: orphan tool result
/// ```
pub fn validate_transcript(messages: &[AgentMessage]) -> Result<(), TranscriptError> {
    let mut pending_calls: HashMap<ToolCallId, usize> = HashMap::new();

    for (i, msg) in messages.iter().enumerate() {
        match msg.role {
            MessageRole::Assistant => {
                for block in &msg.content {
                    if let ContentBlock::ToolUse { call } = block {
                        pending_calls.insert(call.id, i);
                    }
                }
            }
            MessageRole::Tool => {
                for block in &msg.content {
                    if let ContentBlock::ToolResult { call_id, .. } = block {
                        let decl_pos = pending_calls
                            .remove(call_id)
                            .ok_or_else(|| TranscriptError::OrphanToolResult(*call_id))?;
                        if decl_pos > i {
                            return Err(TranscriptError::OutOfOrderToolResult(*call_id));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            MessageRole::User | MessageRole::System => {
                if !pending_calls.is_empty() {
                    let (&id, _) = pending_calls.iter().next().unwrap();
                    return Err(TranscriptError::DanglingToolCall(id));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if let Some((&id, _)) = pending_calls.iter().next() {
        return Err(TranscriptError::UnresolvedToolCall(id));
    }

    Ok(())
}

This file implements the full `Agent::apply()` deterministic state machine — the central transition function for the harness core.

**`Agent::apply(&mut self, command: AgentCommand) -> Vec<AgentEffect>`** — dispatches each command variant to a private handler:

| Handler | State Change | Effects |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `apply_start_run` | `Idle` → `PreparingContext`, sets `active_run` | `StateChanged` + `ExecuteBackend` + `Emit(RunStarted)` |
| `apply_backend_event(TextDelta)` | → `Streaming` | `StateChanged` (if not already) + `Emit(AssistantTextDelta)` |
| `apply_backend_event(ReasoningDelta)` | — | `Emit(ReasoningDelta)` |
| `apply_backend_event(ToolCallRequested)` | Adds to `pending_tools` | `Emit(ToolCallRequested)` |
| `apply_backend_event(UsageUpdate)` | Records usage in ledger | _(none)_ |
| `apply_backend_event(Completed)` | → `Idle`, clears `active_run`, records usage | `StateChanged` + `Emit(Completed(Success))` + `FinishRun` |
| `apply_backend_event(Error)` | → `Failed`, clears `active_run` | `StateChanged` + `Emit(Failed)` + `FinishRun` |
| `apply_tool_completed` | Removes from `pending_tools`, appends tool result to transcript | `Emit(ToolCallCompleted)`, + `ExecuteBackend` if all pending resolved |
| `apply_tool_failed` | Same as completed with error | `Emit(ToolCallCompleted(has_error))`, + `ExecuteBackend` if all resolved |
| `apply_permission_resolved(Approved)` | → `Executing` | `StateChanged` |
| `apply_permission_resolved(Denied)` | → `PreparingContext` | `StateChanged` + `ExecuteBackend` |
| `apply_child_completed` | Removes child from list | `Emit(ChildAgentCompleted(Success))` |
| `apply_child_failed` | Removes child, sets `last_error` | `Emit(ChildAgentCompleted(Failed))` |
| `apply_cancel` | → `Cancelled`, clears `active_run` | `StateChanged` + `Emit(Completed(Cancelled))` |
| `apply_pause` | → `Paused` | `StateChanged` |
| `apply_resume` | → `WaitingForBackend` (if active run) or `Idle` | `StateChanged`, + `ExecuteBackend` if resuming |

**Private helpers:**
- `build_execution_request()` — constructs an `ExecutionRequest` from the agent's current capabilities and transcript.
- `emit_state_changed()` — wraps `AgentEvent::StateChanged` in an `AgentEffect::Emit`.
- `current_assistant_message_id()` — finds the last assistant message in the transcript, or creates a new empty one.

//! Agent state machine transitions.
//!
//! This module implements [`Agent::apply`] — the deterministic transition
//! function that processes [`AgentCommand`]s and produces [`AgentEffect`]s
//! without performing any I/O.
//!
//! # Design
//!
//! Each command variant has a corresponding private `apply_*` method that:
//! 1. Validates preconditions (status checks, ownership checks).
//! 2. Mutates `self.state` and `self.usage`.
//! 3. Returns the exact `Vec<AgentEffect>` the runtime should execute.

use harness_protocol::backend::{ExecutionEvent, ExecutionRequest};
use harness_protocol::commands::{
    AgentCommand, AgentError, AgentResult, AgentStatus, PermissionDecision, UserInput,
};
use harness_protocol::effects::AgentEffect;
use harness_protocol::events::{AgentEvent, AgentOutcome};
use harness_protocol::ids::{AgentId, MessageId, PermissionId, RunId, ToolCallId};
use harness_protocol::messages::{
    AgentMessage, ContentBlock, MessageRole, ToolCall as MsgToolCall,
    ToolResultSummary as MsgToolResultSummary,
};
use harness_protocol::tools::{
    ToolDescriptor, ToolError, ToolResult, ToolResultSummary as ToolsToolResultSummary,
};
use harness_protocol::usage::{Cost, UsageRecord};

use crate::agent::Agent;
use crate::agent_state::PendingToolCall;

impl Agent {
    /// Process a single command and return the resulting effects.
    ///
    /// This is the sole entry point for driving the agent state machine.
    /// It delegates to private `apply_*` methods, one per command variant.
    pub fn apply(&mut self, command: AgentCommand) -> Vec<AgentEffect> {
        match command {
            AgentCommand::StartRun { input } => self.apply_start_run(input),
            AgentCommand::BackendEvent { run_id, event } => self.apply_backend_event(run_id, event),
            AgentCommand::ToolCompleted { call_id, result } => {
                self.apply_tool_completed(call_id, result)
            }
            AgentCommand::ToolFailed { call_id, error } => self.apply_tool_failed(call_id, error),
            AgentCommand::PermissionResolved { id, decision } => {
                self.apply_permission_resolved(id, decision)
            }
            AgentCommand::ChildCompleted { agent_id, result } => {
                self.apply_child_completed(agent_id, result)
            }
            AgentCommand::ChildFailed { agent_id, error } => {
                self.apply_child_failed(agent_id, error)
            }
            AgentCommand::Cancel => self.apply_cancel(),
            AgentCommand::Pause => self.apply_pause(),
            AgentCommand::Resume => self.apply_resume(),
        }
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Private helpers
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// Build an `ExecutionRequest` from the current agent state.
    fn build_execution_request(&self, run_id: RunId) -> ExecutionRequest {
        let enabled_tools: Vec<ToolDescriptor> = self
            .capabilities
            .tools
            .enabled_descriptors()
            .into_iter()
            .cloned()
            .collect();

        ExecutionRequest {
            request_id: harness_protocol::ids::RequestId::new(),
            run_id,
            system_prompt: self.state.system_prompt.clone(),
            messages: self.state.messages.clone(),
            tools: enabled_tools,
            extended_thinking: false,
        }
    }

    /// Emit a `StateChanged` event from `from` to `to`.
    fn emit_state_changed(&self, from: AgentStatus, to: AgentStatus) -> AgentEffect {
        AgentEffect::Emit {
            event: AgentEvent::StateChanged { from, to },
        }
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // apply_start_run
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    fn apply_start_run(&mut self, _input: UserInput) -> Vec<AgentEffect> {
        let run_id = RunId::new();

        self.state.status = AgentStatus::PreparingContext;
        self.state.active_run = Some(run_id);

        let request = self.build_execution_request(run_id);

        vec![
            self.emit_state_changed(AgentStatus::Idle, AgentStatus::PreparingContext),
            AgentEffect::ExecuteBackend { request },
            AgentEffect::Emit {
                event: AgentEvent::RunStarted { run_id },
            },
        ]
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // apply_backend_event
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    fn apply_backend_event(&mut self, run_id: RunId, event: ExecutionEvent) -> Vec<AgentEffect> {
        // Precondition: the event must belong to the active run.
        // In debug builds we assert; in release we silently ignore mismatched events.
        debug_assert_eq!(
            self.state.active_run,
            Some(run_id),
            "BackendEvent for run {run_id} does not match active run {:?}",
            self.state.active_run
        );

        match event {
            ExecutionEvent::TextDelta {
                request_id: _,
                delta,
            } => {
                let from_status = self.state.status;
                self.state.status = AgentStatus::Streaming;

                let mut effects = Vec::new();

                if from_status != AgentStatus::Streaming {
                    effects.push(self.emit_state_changed(from_status, AgentStatus::Streaming));
                }

                let message_id = self.current_assistant_message_id();

                effects.push(AgentEffect::Emit {
                    event: AgentEvent::AssistantTextDelta { message_id, delta },
                });

                effects
            }

            ExecutionEvent::ReasoningDelta {
                request_id: _,
                delta,
            } => {
                let message_id = self.current_assistant_message_id();
                vec![AgentEffect::Emit {
                    event: AgentEvent::ReasoningDelta { message_id, delta },
                }]
            }

            ExecutionEvent::ToolCallRequested {
                request_id: _,
                call,
            } => {
                let call_id = call.id;
                self.state.pending_tools.insert(
                    call_id,
                    PendingToolCall {
                        call: call.clone(),
                        started_at: harness_protocol::ids::Timestamp::now(),
                    },
                );

                vec![AgentEffect::Emit {
                    event: AgentEvent::ToolCallRequested { call },
                }]
            }

            ExecutionEvent::UsageUpdate {
                request_id: _,
                usage,
            } => {
                // Record the usage update into the ledger.
                self.usage.records.push(UsageRecord {
                    model_usage: usage,
                    cost: Cost {
                        amount_usd: None,
                        source: None,
                    },
                    tool_usage: None,
                });

                vec![]
            }

            ExecutionEvent::Completed {
                request_id: _,
                result,
            } => {
                // Record final usage.
                self.usage.records.push(UsageRecord {
                    model_usage: result.usage.clone(),
                    cost: result.cost.clone(),
                    tool_usage: None,
                });

                self.state.active_run = None;
                let from_status = self.state.status;
                self.state.status = AgentStatus::Idle;

                vec![
                    self.emit_state_changed(from_status, AgentStatus::Idle),
                    AgentEffect::Emit {
                        event: AgentEvent::Completed {
                            outcome: AgentOutcome::Success,
                        },
                    },
                    AgentEffect::FinishRun {
                        result: AgentResult {
                            summary: format!("Run completed: {}", result.finish_reason),
                            usage: harness_protocol::usage::AgentUsageSummary::default(),
                        },
                    },
                ]
            }

            ExecutionEvent::Error {
                request_id: _,
                error,
            } => {
                self.state.active_run = None;
                let from_status = self.state.status;
                self.state.status = AgentStatus::Failed;

                let error_msg = format!("{error:?}");
                let agent_error = AgentError {
                    message: error_msg.clone(),
                    code: "BACKEND_ERROR".into(),
                    details: None,
                };
                self.state.last_error = Some(agent_error.clone());

                vec![
                    self.emit_state_changed(from_status, AgentStatus::Failed),
                    AgentEffect::Emit {
                        event: AgentEvent::Failed {
                            error: agent_error,
                        },
                    },
                    AgentEffect::FinishRun {
                        result: AgentResult {
                            summary: format!("Backend error: {error_msg}"),
                            usage: harness_protocol::usage::AgentUsageSummary::default(),
                        },
                    },
                ]
            }
        }
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // apply_tool_completed
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    fn apply_tool_completed(&mut self, call_id: ToolCallId, result: ToolResult) -> Vec<AgentEffect> {
        let _pending = self.state.pending_tools.remove(&call_id);

        // Append a tool-result message to the transcript.
        let tool_result_msg = AgentMessage {
            id: MessageId::new(),
            role: MessageRole::Tool,
            content: vec![ContentBlock::ToolResult {
                call_id,
                result: MsgToolResultSummary {
                    is_error: result.is_error,
                    output: result.output.clone(),
                },
            }],
            created_at: harness_protocol::ids::Timestamp::now(),
        };
        self.state.messages.push(tool_result_msg);

        let output_preview = serde_json::to_string(&result.output).unwrap_or_default();

        let mut effects: Vec<AgentEffect> = vec![AgentEffect::Emit {
            event: AgentEvent::ToolCallCompleted {
                call_id,
                result: ToolsToolResultSummary {
                    has_error: result.is_error,
                    output_preview,
                },
            },
        }];

        // If all pending tools have been resolved and a run is active,
        // issue the next backend request to continue the run.
        if self.state.pending_tools.is_empty() {
            if let Some(run_id) = self.state.active_run {
                self.state.status = AgentStatus::WaitingForBackend;
                let request = self.build_execution_request(run_id);
                effects.push(AgentEffect::ExecuteBackend { request });
            }
        }

        effects
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // apply_tool_failed
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    fn apply_tool_failed(&mut self, call_id: ToolCallId, error: ToolError) -> Vec<AgentEffect> {
        let _pending = self.state.pending_tools.remove(&call_id);

        let error_msg = format!("{error:?}");

        // Append a tool-result message indicating failure.
        let tool_result_msg = AgentMessage {
            id: MessageId::new(),
            role: MessageRole::Tool,
            content: vec![ContentBlock::ToolResult {
                call_id,
                result: MsgToolResultSummary {
                    is_error: true,
                    output: serde_json::json!({ "error": error_msg }),
                },
            }],
            created_at: harness_protocol::ids::Timestamp::now(),
        };
        self.state.messages.push(tool_result_msg);

        let mut effects: Vec<AgentEffect> = vec![AgentEffect::Emit {
            event: AgentEvent::ToolCallCompleted {
                call_id,
                result: ToolsToolResultSummary {
                    has_error: true,
                    output_preview: error_msg.clone(),
                },
            },
        }];

        // If all pending tools resolved, issue next backend request.
        if self.state.pending_tools.is_empty() {
            if let Some(run_id) = self.state.active_run {
                self.state.status = AgentStatus::WaitingForBackend;
                let request = self.build_execution_request(run_id);
                effects.push(AgentEffect::ExecuteBackend { request });
            }
        }

        effects
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // apply_permission_resolved
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    fn apply_permission_resolved(
        &mut self,
        _id: PermissionId,
        decision: PermissionDecision,
    ) -> Vec<AgentEffect> {
        match decision {
            PermissionDecision::Approved => {
                self.state.status = AgentStatus::Executing;
                vec![self.emit_state_changed(
                    AgentStatus::WaitingForPermission,
                    AgentStatus::Executing,
                )]
            }
            PermissionDecision::Denied => {
                self.state.status = AgentStatus::PreparingContext;

                let mut effects = vec![self.emit_state_changed(
                    AgentStatus::WaitingForPermission,
                    AgentStatus::PreparingContext,
                )];

                // Continue the run by sending another backend request.
                if let Some(run_id) = self.state.active_run {
                    let request = self.build_execution_request(run_id);
                    effects.push(AgentEffect::ExecuteBackend { request });
                }

                effects
            }
        }
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // apply_child_completed
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    fn apply_child_completed(
        &mut self,
        agent_id: AgentId,
        _result: AgentResult,
    ) -> Vec<AgentEffect> {
        self.state.children.retain(|id| *id != agent_id);

        vec![AgentEffect::Emit {
            event: AgentEvent::ChildAgentCompleted {
                agent_id,
                outcome: AgentOutcome::Success,
            },
        }]
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // apply_child_failed
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    fn apply_child_failed(&mut self, agent_id: AgentId, error: AgentError) -> Vec<AgentEffect> {
        self.state.children.retain(|id| *id != agent_id);
        self.state.last_error = Some(error.clone());

        vec![AgentEffect::Emit {
            event: AgentEvent::ChildAgentCompleted {
                agent_id,
                outcome: AgentOutcome::Failed,
            },
        }]
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // apply_cancel
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    fn apply_cancel(&mut self) -> Vec<AgentEffect> {
        let from_status = self.state.status;
        self.state.status = AgentStatus::Cancelled;
        self.state.active_run = None;

        vec![
            self.emit_state_changed(from_status, AgentStatus::Cancelled),
            AgentEffect::Emit {
                event: AgentEvent::Completed {
                    outcome: AgentOutcome::Cancelled,
                },
            },
        ]
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // apply_pause
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    fn apply_pause(&mut self) -> Vec<AgentEffect> {
        let from_status = self.state.status;
        self.state.status = AgentStatus::Paused;

        vec![self.emit_state_changed(from_status, AgentStatus::Paused)]
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // apply_resume
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    fn apply_resume(&mut self) -> Vec<AgentEffect> {
        let mut effects = Vec::new();

        if self.state.active_run.is_some() {
            self.state.status = AgentStatus::WaitingForBackend;
            effects.push(self.emit_state_changed(
                AgentStatus::Paused,
                AgentStatus::WaitingForBackend,
            ));

            if let Some(run_id) = self.state.active_run {
                let request = self.build_execution_request(run_id);
                effects.push(AgentEffect::ExecuteBackend { request });
            }
        } else {
            self.state.status = AgentStatus::Idle;
            effects.push(self.emit_state_changed(AgentStatus::Paused, AgentStatus::Idle));
        }

        effects
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helper: get or create the current assistant message ID
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /// Returns the `MessageId` of the last assistant message in the transcript,
    /// or creates a new empty assistant message and returns its ID.
    fn current_assistant_message_id(&mut self) -> MessageId {
        for msg in self.state.messages.iter().rev() {
            if msg.role == MessageRole::Assistant {
                return msg.id;
            }
        }

        // No assistant message exists yet — create one.
        let message_id = MessageId::new();
        let assistant_msg = AgentMessage {
            id: message_id,
            role: MessageRole::Assistant,
            content: Vec::new(),
            created_at: harness_protocol::ids::Timestamp::now(),
        };
        self.state.messages.push(assistant_msg);
        message_id
    }
}

pub fn validate_transcript(messages: &[AgentMessage]) -> Result<(), TranscriptError> {
    let mut pending_calls: HashMap<ToolCallId, usize> = HashMap::new();

    for (i, msg) in messages.iter().enumerate() {
        match msg.role {
            MessageRole::Assistant => {
                for block in &msg.content {
                    if let ContentBlock::ToolUse { call } = block {
                        pending_calls.insert(call.id, i);
                    }
                }
            }
            MessageRole::Tool => {
                for block in &msg.content {
                    if let ContentBlock::ToolResult { call_id, .. } = block {
                        let decl_pos = pending_calls.remove(call_id)
                            .ok_or_else(|| TranscriptError::OrphanToolResult(*call_id))?;
                        if decl_pos > i {
                            return Err(TranscriptError::OutOfOrderToolResult(*call_id));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            MessageRole::User | MessageRole::System => {
                if !pending_calls.is_empty() {
                    let (&id, _) = pending_calls.iter().next().unwrap();
                    return Err(TranscriptError::DanglingToolCall(id));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if let Some((&id, _)) = pending_calls.iter().next() {
        return Err(TranscriptError::UnresolvedToolCall(id));
    }

    Ok(())
}

impl UsageLedger {
    pub fn new() -> Self { UsageLedger { records: Vec::new() } }

    pub fn add_record(&mut self, record: UsageRecord) {
        self.records.push(record);
    }

    pub fn self_usage(&self) -> ModelUsage {
        self.aggregate(&self.records)
    }

    fn aggregate(&self, records: &[UsageRecord]) -> ModelUsage {
        let mut result = ModelUsage::default();
        for record in records {
            result = ModelUsage {
                input_tokens: result.input_tokens.checked_add(record.usage.input_tokens),
                output_tokens: result.output_tokens.checked_add(record.usage.output_tokens),
                ..result
            };
        }
        result
    }
}

pub fn compute_agent_usage_summary(
    self_records: &[UsageRecord],
    child_summaries: &[AgentUsageSummary],
) -> AgentUsageSummary {
    let self_usage = UsageLedger { records: self_records.to_vec() }.self_usage();

    let mut descendant_usage = ModelUsage::default();
    for child in child_summaries {
        descendant_usage = ModelUsage {
            input_tokens: descendant_usage.input_tokens.checked_add(
                child.inclusive_usage.input_tokens
            ),
            ..descendant_usage
        };
    }

    let inclusive_usage = ModelUsage {
        input_tokens: self_usage.input_tokens.checked_add(descendant_usage.input_tokens),
        ..ModelUsage::default()
    };

    AgentUsageSummary {
        self_usage,
        descendant_usage,
        inclusive_usage,
    }
}

[package]
name = "harness-core"
version = "0.1.0"
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
repository.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true
publish = false

[dependencies]
harness-protocol = { path = "../harness-protocol" }
serde_json.workspace = true
thiserror.workspace = true
rust_decimal.workspace = true
{"files.enable_file_search": false}

[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = [
    "crates/harness-protocol",
    "crates/harness-core",
    "crates/harness-runtime",
    "crates/harness-engine",
    "crates/harness-model",
    "crates/harness-generic-backend",
    "crates/harness-tools",
    "crates/harness-context",
    "crates/harness-workspace",
    "crates/harness-session-store",
    "crates/harness-extension-api",
    "crates/integrations/anthropic",
    "crates/integrations/openai",
    "crates/integrations/gemini",
    "crates/integrations/openai-compatible",
    "crates/integrations/claude-code",
    "crates/integrations/codex",
    "crates/tools/filesystem",
    "crates/tools/shell",
    "crates/tools/git",
    "crates/transports/websocket",
    "crates/transports/stdio",
    "crates/transports/ipc",
    "apps/harness",
    "apps/harnessd",
    "apps/harnessctl",
]
exclude = ["xtask"]

[workspace.package]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.78"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/suciuvictortraian/rusty-core"
authors = ["Victor Suciu Traian"]

[workspace.dependencies]
tokio = { version = "1", default-features = false }
tokio-util = "0.7"

serde_json = "1"

schemars = "0.8"

anyhow = "1"
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter", "fmt"] }
